name: French A1.2
description: In this module, students expand their basic knowledge of French lexis and grammar for simple oral and written for every-day communication situations. They learn, for example, to pose questions to others about themselves and their families and to answer similar questions, to make arrangements as well as reservations in hotels, to report on free time and holiday activities, to describe past events and habits. Grammar covered will include: Passé Composé, Futur proche, quantities, possessive pronouns, direct and indirect object pronouns. Strategies will be taught enabling students with minimal language skills to successfully manage basic everyday situations. Moreover, opportunities will be made available to more effectively organize the learning process of French as a foreign language and to improve the ability to learn.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of level A1.1; placement test result A1.2.
